name: io.github.aemery13/polymarket-intel
title: Polymarket Wallet Intelligence
description: Classifies Polymarket wallets as human or bot, scores their trading edge (0-10), and exposes their current open positions. Designed for AI agents building copy-trading or signal-following systems on Polymarket.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_INTEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits and paid features. Anonymous access works at free-tier limits.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits.
